purpose: Reading the GilbVeda master's term documents, each request and each whole reading bounded in time, so a master that does not answer is "not known yet" and never "nothing".
namedChanges: the imports of the source's own files (`./terms.ts`, `./deadline.ts`, `./source.ts`) are the unit's own files without `.ts` (the host-agnostic check allows `./name` only); no import of another package is needed;
the header comment of each file is a new, shorter one, and comments that name a host, a person, an agent or a ticket are reworded; no code changed.
